translation_direction: zh → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Chinese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The mock-scholarly narrator of chapter I keeps Hán-Việt genre names (liệt truyện, tự truyện, … chính truyện) and the Confucian tags untranslated in Hán-Việt.
decisions.rationale: The parody of biography conventions depends on the learned register.

decisions.decision: A Q says tao/mày to equals and inferiors, con before cụ Triệu and at the tribunal, tôi to the Fake Foreign Devil, and pleads with chị Ngô in tôi/chị.
decisions.rationale: Register tracks A Q’s self-abasement and bluster.

decisions.decision: 『』 as “ ” and 「」 as ‘ ’; the dealer’s drawl marks ～～ rendered as ellipses; opera lines keep their line breaks.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: A Q’s kneeling proposal to Wu Ma no longer sounds like a threat (tao/mày replaced by a pleading tôi/chị).
Full-width drawl marks replaced by Vietnamese ellipses (also 9.33 sound effect).
竟, 驟然大闊, 一向, 調戲, 一臺戲, 娼婦們 corrected; 小烏龜子 insult given sting; opera titles and 閒人 unified across parts; several calques recast.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The established Vietnamese term for A Q’s method; the ‘son beats father’ formula (con đánh bố) is fixed wherever it recurs.

glossary.source_term: 假洋鬼子 / 趙太爺 / 秀才 / 小D
glossary.draft_rendering: thằng Tây giả / cụ Triệu / cậu tú / D Con
glossary.rationale: Hán-Việt and nickname renderings stable across both drafting parts.

glossary.draft_rendering: Đảng Dầu Hồng (for Đảng Tự do)
glossary.rationale: Keeps the villagers’ mishearing as a mishearing.

witness_decision: Selected the Chinese Wikisource transclusion «阿Q正傳» (revision 2633268) of 魯迅全集 vol. 1 (1938 edition, 1948 printing), Page namespace pages 380–437, all marked proofread (level 3). First serialised in 晨報副刊, 4 December 1921 – 12 February 1922, and collected in 吶喊 (1923); not collated with the serial text.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The witness reads 趙太爺未進秀才 where other editions read 趙大爺 (the son); the translation follows the selected witness.
The witness typo 情神 (for 精神) is translated by sense; it is recorded, not emended.

title_review.rationale: A Q chính truyện follows the established Vietnamese title and the glossary’s chính truyện for 正傳.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Chapter I’s parody of biography genres kept in Hán-Việt.
The wolf’s eyes, the crowd’s verdict and the dateline.
